top_signals.title: DARPA Backs Project to Measure AI Energy Use at Every Stage of the Workflow
top_signals.summary: The artificial intelligence boom is creating an energy monster. The indiscriminate integration of machine learning into everything from from our energy grids to our electric toothbrushes – no, really – has created a global race to build up data center capacity as quickly as humanly possible, causing energy demand projections to skyrocket and placing unprecedented strain on the world’s energy grids. top_signals.title: Chevron Raises Exploration Spending By 50%
top_signals.summary: After years of focusing on growing exploration and production in the U.S. Gulf of Mexico and the Permian shale basin, U.S. oil and gas supermajor Chevron returns to high-impact frontier exploration as it seeks to renew its portfolio with diverse opportunities globally. top_signals.title: Europe Is Now Seriously Rethinking Its Oil Refinery Phase Down
top_signals.summary: Over the past couple of decades, Europe has pursued some of the world’s most ambitious clean energy policies, aiming to become the first climate-neutral continent by 2050.
